# TOOLFLUX

> Carbide cutting tools supplier based in Hubli, Karnataka, delivering across India. Inserts, solid carbide drills, end mills, indexable and turning holders, and the SUPER-U / HYPER-U U-Drill system, with on-site application support.

## Products

- [Carbide cutting tools](https://www.toolflux.co.in/): turning, milling, threading, grooving, CBN and drilling inserts; solid carbide drills; end mills; indexable holders (HFMA/HFMB high-feed, D16 to D63); turning holders; U-Drill Ø8.5 to 70 mm in 2D, 3D and 5D
- Grades: TFX-P25 (ISO P, steel), TFX-M35 (ISO M, stainless), TFX-K20 (ISO K, cast iron), TFX-U15 (ISO N, aluminium), TFX-S30 (ISO S), TFX-H15 / TFX-H10 (CBN, hardened steel up to 60 HRC)

## Software

- [Machlog](https://www.toolflux.co.in/machining-log.html): shop-floor software that tracks insert life and cost per component. Paid plans: Solo ₹299, Shop ₹799, Works ₹2,499 per month, with a 14-day free trial
